item.title: UTA Researcher Tests Plastic-Infused Asphalt That Could Extend Road Life in Texas Heat
item.description: Dallas Innovates, Every Day: Here's what's new + next in North Texas. A University of Texas at Arlington civil engineering researcher is testing a new type of asphalt made with recycled plastic that could help roads last longer, resist cracking in extreme heat, and reduce plastic waste. UTA professor Sahadat Hossain developed a method that replaces part of the petroleum-based binder used in asphalt with recycled plastic from everyday items such as plastic bags and bottles.… The post UTA Research
